summary: Tested POS discount feature (% and flat ₹) end-to-end. All backend tests pass. UI discount feature works correctly - toggles, input, totals panel updates in real-time. Order placement and receipt navigation work. Found 1 bug: Receipt's GST Summary table shows pre-discount taxable/cgst/sgst values instead of post-discount values.

ui_bugs.issue: GST Summary table computes taxable/cgst/sgst from raw item price*qty (lines 35-41 in Receipt.js) WITHOUT applying discount. Shows wrong pre-discount values. E.g. 10% discount on ₹150 product: summary shows Taxable=150, CGST=13.50 instead of correct Taxable=135, CGST=12.15. The main totals section above (using order.taxable_value) shows correct values.
ui_bugs.selector: GST Summary table in Receipt page
ui_bugs.fix: In Receipt.js lines 35-41, the gstRows computation must scale down item values proportionally by (1 - discount/subtotal), or use order-level taxable_value distributed per HSN.

action_items: Fix Receipt.js GST Summary table to apply discount proportion when computing per-HSN taxable/cgst/sgst values
critical_code_review_comments: Receipt.js lines 35-41: gstRows sums price*qty per HSN without considering discount. Should multiply by (taxable_value/subtotal) ratio or distribute discount proportionally.
All other discount logic is correctly implemented: frontend totals, backend computation, receipt main totals

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work, minor receipt GST summary display bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Discount feature fully working. All 3 discount types (none/percent/flat) work in UI with correct real-time totals. Backend correctly computes discount, taxable, cgst, sgst and stores in order. Receipt main totals section is correct. Only bug: Receipt GST Summary table (bottom section per HSN) shows pre-discount values. This is a frontend-only bug in Receipt.js lines 35-41.

rca_of_issue.gst_summary_pre_discount: Receipt.js builds gstRows by summing item.price * item.qty per HSN code. This is the gross subtotal before discount. The discount is an order-level field not applied at item level, so the GST summary table bypasses it. Fix: multiply each HSN's taxable by (order.taxable_value / order.subtotal) ratio to get the discount-adjusted taxable per HSN.
